question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb4eb6357dc45bebbf23b9bef8389f4a888a19eb0ac503b55dabce3f3f9cf9f6.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• Number of lines in outside figure is decreasing by 1.
 
• Number of lines in inner figure is increasing by 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b90c490b3b2df6c1967c989df83dfdc9af3b62a822990d7fe5b07e8ad907ae29.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
